{{Top}}
'''Reflec''' was an advanced, light-warping, [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] stopping [[Wikipedia:polymer|polymer]] used on the armor of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Covert Ops clone trooper]]s and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Storm commando/Legends|Storm commandos]].

The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Mist (bounty hunter)|Mist]] also wore armor with a reflec coating, allowing her to gain the upper hand on her quarry.

Professional dancers and the staff at the [[Glow Dome]] wore reflec bodysuits, which absorbed and reflected the illumination in the club.
